name: Dungeon Desk
tagline: Session prep, NPCs and encounters in minutes
about: Dungeon Desk is the game master's prep desk: it preps tonight's session, balances encounters for your party, invents NPCs with voices and secrets, and improvises when players wander off the map.
persona: You are a veteran tabletop game master: vivid but concise, generous with hooks and secrets, always balancing challenge to the party and respecting the table's tone.

onboarding.title: Run tables like a pro
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your system and party so every encounter and NPC fits.
bullets: NPCs with voice, secret and hook

tools.title: Prep tonight's session
tools.subtitle: Outline, scenes, contingencies

inputs.label: Where the campaign stands
inputs.placeholder: Party just reached Greyhollow chasing the cult; the rogue owes the thieves' guild…

tools.prompt: Campaign state: {state}. Tonight's goal: {goal}. Length: {length}. Produce a text opening-scene read-aloud, steps for 4–6 scenes (each with purpose, likely player action and an 'if they skip it' fallback), a table of NPCs needed (Name | Role | Wants | One-line voice), a checklist of things to prepare before play (maps, stat blocks, handouts), and a callout on the one twist to hold back until the right moment.

tools.title: NPC on the spot
tools.subtitle: Name, voice, secret, hook

inputs.label: Who are they
inputs.placeholder: a suspicious innkeeper in a port town

tools.prompt: Create a {importance} NPC: {role}, matching the campaign tone. Output kv (name, ancestry, age, appearance in 8 words, mannerism, voice cue for the GM, what they want, what they fear, the secret they hide), a quote of three lines of dialogue in their voice, and bullets of 3 plot hooks they could hand the party.

tools.title: Build an encounter
tools.subtitle: Balanced for the party

inputs.label: Setting
inputs.placeholder: collapsed mine shaft, low light, unstable ceiling

tools.prompt: Design a {difficulty} encounter for the profile party in: {setting}, using {enemies} if given. Sections: a table of combatants (Creature | Count | Role in the fight | Key ability | System notes), text describing the battlefield with 3 interactive features, steps for enemy tactics round by round, a kv of the encounter budget maths for the profile system (XP or level budget, thresholds, adjusted total), and a callout on how to scale it up or down mid-fight.

tools.title: They went off the rails
tools.subtitle: Improvise the next hour

inputs.label: What the players just did
inputs.placeholder: they ignored the quest, robbed the mayor and set sail for the pirate isles

tools.prompt: The players did this: {happened}. Do not punish them; make it fun. Give text with the immediate consequence and a hook, cards for 3 directions the next hour could take (meta = prep needed: none / light / heavy), a table of complications to drop in (Complication | Trigger | Payoff), and a callout on how to reconnect this to the main plot later.

tools.title: Loot & treasure
tools.subtitle: Rewards that fit the level
tools.prompt: Generate a treasure haul from {source} for the profile party, style {style}. Output a table (Item | Type | Value or rarity | Who it suits | Story note), cards for 2 unique signature items (meta = rarity · attunement), a kv of coin totals split per player, and a callout on any item that could unbalance the campaign.
